angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 577,431 km at 176.54 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6646 +/- 0.0110 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 176.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.83 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Kunimoto et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract): 577,431 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.88 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Kunimoto et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4960 +/- 36 K from Kunimoto et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Kunimoto et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4010 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4010.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.544, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): spectral type K V, from Kunimoto et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-4010: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.37 dex, from Kunimoto et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.3996, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): age 6.1 Gyr, from Kunimoto et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): rotation period 37.7 d, from Kunimoto et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4010 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.3 km/s, from Kunimoto et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166....7K/abstract)
